pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation: pinewood was cut into small pieces using a carpentry chopper (Rasha WSH-T64) and then powdered using a grinder (Bosch MKM6003) and screened using a Mesh 20 sieve.

Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) pretreatment: presoaking pinewood in 8% wt. sodium hydroxide solution at room temperature for 10 min with stirring, followed by heating to 100 °C in a stainless steel reactor for 10 min.
Liquid hot water (LHW) pretreatment: pinewood was processed using distilled water instead of alkaline solution, following the same steps as NaOH pretreatment (heating to 100 °C for 10 min).
Biological pretreatment (aerobic digestion): addition of 20 mL aerobic sludge and 5 mL tap water to pinewood (untreated or pretreated) at 37 °C and 90 rpm in a shaker incubator for 10 days.
Ultrasonic pretreatment: incubation of substrates/slurry in an ultrasonic bath at a frequency of 40 KHz for 30 min at 40 °C with a power of 180 W.
